identity.mission: Create a project prediction tool that feels like a high-end architectural studio, not a generic SaaS. Precision, Authority, and Structural Beauty.
principles: Fusion over Imitation: Mix 'Swiss Typographic Poster' with 'Industrial Blueprint' aesthetics.
Emotion First: The user should feel 'In Control' and 'Future-Ready'.
Content is King: Data is the hero. Use whitespace to let numbers breathe.
Zoom In: Focus on the 'Cost' and 'Time' metrics like they are headlines.

rules.subheadings: font-general font-medium tracking-wide uppercase text-xs text-slate-500

colors.theme_strategy: Smart Toggle (Default: Light for planning, Dark available for deep work)

secondary.name: Precision Teal
secondary.usage: Success states, Progress bars, Active links

accent.name: Safety Orange
accent.usage: Call to Actions (High Priority), Alerts, Highlights

visual_enhancers.texture: Add a subtle 'noise' overlay (opacity 0.03) to the background to give it a paper/concrete feel. No dead flat colors.
visual_enhancers.borders: Use 'Micro-Borders'. 1px solid borders in Slate-200. On hover, darken to Slate-900. Sharp, not soft.
visual_enhancers.shadows: Hard shadows for cards: 'shadow-[4px_4px_0px_0px_rgba(15,23,42,0.1)]'. No soft blurs. Architectural feel.
visual_enhancers.glassmorphism: Use sparingly. Only for the sticky navigation. 'backdrop-blur-md bg-white/80 border-b border-slate-200/50'.

layout.spacing_scale: 2x Standard. If you think p-4 is enough, use p-8.

grid_system.dashboard: Bento Grid (Mode B). Dense, interlocking rectangular cards. No gaps in data.
grid_system.landing: Tetris Grid (Mode A). Asymmetrical. Large typography paired with negative space.

buttons.primary: bg-slate-900 text-white rounded-none px-8 py-3 hover:bg-slate-800 transition-all shadow-[4px_4px_0px_0px_#0D9488] hover:shadow-none hover:translate-x-[2px] hover:translate-y-[2px]
buttons.secondary: bg-white border-2 border-slate-200 text-slate-900 rounded-none px-8 py-3 hover:border-slate-900 transition-colors

cards.default: bg-white border border-slate-200 p-8 rounded-sm hover:border-slate-400 transition-colors relative overflow-hidden
cards.prediction_result: Use the 'Tracing Beam' effect. A glowing teal line moving around the border to signify 'AI Calculation'.

inputs.style: bg-slate-50 border-b-2 border-slate-200 focus:border-slate-900 rounded-t-sm px-4 py-3 outline-none transition-colors placeholder:text-slate-400
inputs.label: uppercase text-xs font-bold text-slate-500 mb-1 block

motion.entrance: Staggered fade-up for dashboard elements. 'initial={{opacity: 0, y: 20}} animate={{opacity: 1, y: 0}} transition={{duration: 0.4, delay: i * 0.1}}'
motion.interaction: Buttons and Cards must have 'active:scale-95' for tactile feedback.
motion.loading: Use an ASCII-style spinner or a 'Construction Progress Bar' (striped) instead of a generic circle loader.

images.desc: Abstract blue/white geometric pattern. Use as a low-opacity background overlay (opacity-10) in the Hero section.
Modern building under construction. Use for the 'Construction Projects' selection card.
Wires/Abstract Tech. Use for the 'Software Projects' selection card.

media.icons: Use 'Phosphor Icons' (Regular weight). They look technical and precise.

landing.hero: Split screen or Center-Heavy. Headline: 'Predict the Future of Your Build.' Subtext: 'AI-driven cost and timeline estimation for the modern era.'
landing.features: Bento grid showing 'Cost Accuracy', 'Timeline Prediction', and 'Team Composition' as widget-style cards.

auth.layout: Split screen. Left side: Form. Right side: The 'Construction Card' image with a dark overlay and a quote about planning.

dashboard.layout: Sidebar navigation (collapsible). Main area: 'Project Input' (Text Area) on top, 'Results Grid' below.
dashboard.results_panel: Must look like a 'Mission Report'. distinct sections for Cost, Time, Team. Use counters that roll up to the final number.

accessibility.contrast: Ensure Slate-500 text is only used on White. Use Slate-600 for better legibility.
accessibility.focus: Focus rings must be 'ring-2 ring-slate-900 ring-offset-2'.
accessibility.labels: All form inputs must have visible labels.

universal_guidelines: Do not use gradients for text.
Do not use rounded-xl or rounded-2xl. Keep it sharp (rounded-sm or rounded-md).
Do not center-align long text blocks.
Use data-testid for all interactive elements.
instructions_to_main_agent: 2. Setup the font import in index.css immediately.
3. Create the 'Layout' component first with the Sidebar and Header.
4. Build the 'PredictionCard' component with the tracing beam effect before assembling the dashboard.
5. Use 'recharts' for any data visualization (e.g., cost breakdown pie chart).
